bundle.shortDescription: Share one keyboard, mouse, clipboard and files across your LAN.
bundle.longDescription: UnionDesk lets one keyboard and mouse drive several machines on the same local network, keeps the clipboard in step and moves files between them. All traffic is end to end encrypted.
